unit_convention: angles reported in degrees; controller joints/yaw in radians; distances m; time s

legacy_open_80deg_actual20.warning: Original name open_80deg does NOT mean 80 degrees with defaults

open80.aggregation: final; ever_open80 is a separate cumulative event

success.formula: unlocked AND final signed_angle_deg>=80 AND rear_clearance_m>=0.52
success.adaptation: 0.55 m target minus original 0.03 m tolerance; door normal projection with current-yaw rear offset; kinematic base only, not locomotion

reach.adaptation: latched episode event, evaluated independently of curriculum; 10/60 s

grasp.formula: ee_to_handle_m<0.12 AND commanded_closure>0.65 AND actual_closure>0.35 for 10 consecutive simulation steps
grasp.adaptation: latched diagnostic event, not force/contact-verified grasp; independently evaluated instead of curriculum-dependent buffer

phase_success.adaptation: report reach, grasp, unlocked, open80, success separately; these diagnostic stages never control actions

signed_open_ratio.adaptation: Reuses floating expert door_hinge_open_ratio, which is absolute despite this compatibility field name. Correct push direction is enforced separately by signed_angle_deg for success; differs from RL signed ratio clipping [-1,1.2].

handle_open_ratio.adaptation: raw ratio retained; unlock threshold=40/45, matching expert task

arm_base_to_handle_m.adaptation: norm(base origin + rotated [0.2,0,0.1] - handle goal), metric only

fk_goal_to_handle_m.formula: norm(FK(commanded joint positions) in world - live_handle_goal_world)
fk_goal_to_handle_m.warning: Not original ee_goal_to_handle_m: policy outputs joint targets, not a Cartesian goal

fk_ee_tracking_m.formula: norm(FK(commanded joint positions) in world - measured EE world)

fk_validation_m.formula: norm(FK(measured joint positions) in world - measured EE world)

action_l2.source: door_dp_common.py applied_action logging; NEW action schema
action_l2.warning: mixed physical units; per-channel traces are the primary interpretation

train_loss.warning: not action MSE, reward, or task success

val_loss.formula: same noise MSE on 4 fixed batches of 16 held-out windows with fixed diffusion noise

inference_latency.formula: wall time including observation encoding and 25 DDPM steps, synchronized by CPU action transfer; separate first-call latency; queued actions excluded from decision percentiles

ever_open80.warning: May include locked-door collision spikes; not task success; degrees

rear_clearance_m.source: NEW learning/float_env.py:220 FloatEnv.metrics; derived from .repro/float-push/verify_push.py run
rear_clearance_m.adaptation: Fixed door normal and conservative longitudinal extent; does not check lateral doorway containment or leg collisions

action_delta_l2.units: mixed m/s,rad/s,rad; per 1/60 s step; multiply by60 for per-second change

elapsed_sec.formula: previous checkpoint training elapsed + monotonic time since current training loop start
elapsed_sec.units: seconds, excludes process setup/data loading; budget.jsonl independently includes whole process wall-time

depth_audit.limitation: Early depth_m arrays are metric depth after nonfinite replacement and clipping to [0,2] m; not original unprocessed sensor depth

raw_gym_depth_audit.formula: copy signed Gym IMAGE_DEPTH values before all transformations
raw_gym_depth_audit.units: m, original negative camera depth with -inf background permitted
raw_gym_depth_audit.scope: recording-audit only; not available for early training collection
